rows.current: text: 啊——见鬼。真见鬼，见鬼见鬼，见了个大头鬼！

rows.source: Don't you wobbly eye me, you hecking Flayer! I ain't falling for it!
rows.current: text: 别拿那晃眼的招数对付我，混账剥心魔！我才不上当！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You think I'm some rookie whose brain is gonna melt just because you're staring
rows.current: text: 你以为我是那种被你使劲瞪着看，就会脑袋融化的菜鸟？想得美！我的脑子可不是你的午间零食！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: at me too real hard? Think again! My mind isn't your midday snack!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Gyah, putting those tentacles to use too are ya? Well it'sh no ushe.
rows.current: text: 呀啊，你连触手也用上了？哼，没用的。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ShI'mn owt ohnnah get maeh mindh yeathen...
rows.current: text: 窝才不会让你把脑纸吃掉……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ooOOoooohhoHHhHh...!
rows.current: text: 哦哦噢噢啊啊啊……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [EDITOR'S NOTE: Agent Yiffany Yiffai did indeed succumb to the Mind Flayer.]
rows.current: text: [编者注：特工伊吠妮·伊吠确实败给了剥心魔。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [Despite her impressive resiliance to the Flayer's hypnotic eye, the Agent]
rows.current: text: [这名特工虽对剥心魔的催眠眼展现出惊人的抵抗力，]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [was still not able to overcome the namesake flaying of the mind.]
rows.current: text: [仍未能抵御那令剥心魔得名的心智剥离。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [The rest of the Agent's experience seems to consist of them having been]
rows.current: text: [此后，这名特工似乎先被抽干心智，]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [mentally drained and then passed off to another local fauna of Tutone.]
rows.current: text: [再被交给图托恩的另一种本土生物。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [In a sort of symbiotic cooperation, Flayers seem to mentally drain a victim]
rows.current: text: [两者似乎有着某种共生关系：剥心魔先抽干受害者的心智，]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [before allowing another creature to keep the victim as an energy source.]
rows.current: text: [再交由另一种生物圈养，充作能量来源。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [With mental incapacitation complete, the victim is nestled into a tentacle bed]
rows.current: text: [待受害者心智彻底失能，便会被安置进触手床中]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [where constant sexual gratification keeps them placated.]
rows.current: text: [持续不断的性满足让受害者安分下来。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [These are extraordinary findings that the Agent will no doubt appreciate]
rows.current: text: [这些非凡的发现，想必会让该特工十分欣喜，]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [as soon as their mental facilities are returned to them!]
rows.current: text: [等她恢复心智能力后！]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [We have many additional agents heading to Tutone to investigate further]
rows.current: text: [我们正增派多名特工前往图托恩，展开进一步调查]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [so that we can return Yiffany, one of our most prized Agents,]
rows.current: text: [以便让我们最珍视的特工之一，伊吠妮，]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [to her previous state.]
rows.current: text: [恢复到原先的状态。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [Until Yiffany is capable once more, her file will be placed on hold. -EDITOR]
rows.current: text: [伊吠妮恢复行动能力前，本档案暂缓更新。——编者]

rows.source: [STARDATE XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [PLANET TUTONE, 5555 SYSTEM] [MAGNETOSHEATH ENTRY POINT]
rows.current: text: [星历XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [5555星系，图托恩星] [磁鞘进入点]

rows.source: ...entry successful, en route to descend at 40N, 74W in T-minus XXXX unisecs.
rows.current: text: ……成功进入，正前往40N、74W下降点，距下降还有XXXX标准秒。

rows.source: Engine temp stable at 2640 degrees, plasma, oxygen and battery levels good.
rows.current: text: 引擎温度稳定在2640度，等离子、氧气和电量均正常。

rows.source: This is Cosmobreeder Yiffany, can I get a mission update, Bossu?
rows.current: text: 这里是宇宙育种者伊吠妮。波苏，能更新下任务情报吗？

rows.source: That's commanding officer Bossu, Yiffany. Don't forget that!
rows.current: text: 要叫波苏指挥官，伊吠妮。别忘了！

rows.source: We here at HQ are all thankful that you took this mission on short notice.
rows.current: text: 总部上下都很感谢你临时接下这次任务。

rows.source: Oh yeah, no problem! If my little bro is all tangled up in it like you say he is
rows.current: text: 当然，没问题！要是我弟真像你说的那样卷进去了，那救他的机会，我说什么也不会错过！

rows.source: then I wouldn't miss being the one to rescue him for the world!
It's sad that your brother Yiffai's first deployment ended up this way
rows.current: text: 真遗憾，你弟弟伊吠的首次任务竟会变成这样，

rows.source: but there were more experienced agents on the same mission as he was.
rows.current: text: 可同一趟任务里，还有比他更有经验的特工。

rows.source: You know the drill. Tutone is having a mass exodus of fauna
rows.current: text: 流程你都清楚。图托恩正在发生动物大规模外逃，

rows.source: and your job is to find out why!
rows.current: text: 你的任务就是查明原因！

rows.source: On top of that, you should also look for your missing fellow agents.
rows.current: text: 除此之外，你还得寻找失踪的特工同伴。

rows.source: Just make...sur...ou...on your...oes...or....
rows.current: text: 只要确……保……你……多加……小……心……

rows.source: Oh? What's this? Another little spacebug entering my domain?
rows.current: text: 哦？这是什么？又一只小太空虫闯进了我的领地？

rows.source: Enjoy your crash landing like your other little interlopers did, puppy!
rows.current: text: 小狗，跟先前那些小入侵者一样，好好享受坠机吧！

rows.source: What? Just who the heck are you?
rows.current: text: 什么？你到底是谁？

rows.source: And where the heck did all these ships come from?
rows.current: text: 还有，这些飞船到底打哪儿来的？

rows.source: Alright this is a little ruffer than I was expecting!
rows.current: text: 好吧，这可比我预想的颠得厉害！

rows.source: If you can hear me Bossu my engine's been hit! Making emergency descent!
rows.current: text: 波苏，听见了吗？引擎中弹！正在紧急下降！
text: ……好疼。

rows.source: Well, I guess that's what I get for not taking things serious up there.
rows.current: text: 唉，这大概就是我在上头掉以轻心的报应。

rows.source: Gotta remember that there were some experienced agents that went missing
rows.current: text: 得记住，失踪的还有好些经验丰富的特工，可不止我家小弟！

rows.source: not just my baby bro!
This ol' ship should be good to go for low orbit maneuvers at least.
rows.current: text: 这老飞船至少还能在低轨道上机动。

rows.source: I oughtta get more than just my flight jacket on, and maybe take a look around...
rows.current: text: 我该多穿点，不能光披飞行夹克，再四处看看……

rows.source: Hey, wait a minute!!
rows.current: text: 喂，等等啊！！

rows.source: What the heck do you think you're doing you little thief?!?
rows.current: text: 你这小贼，搞什么鬼呢？！？

rows.source: Seriously? Escaping down some dingy dark little hole?
rows.current: text: 不是吧？竟然钻进又脏又黑的小洞逃跑？

rows.source: Maaaan, this is NOT how I like my missions to start out!
rows.current: text: 天哪，我可不想任务一开始就这么倒霉！

rows.source: Some big haired punk and her floozies shooting me down...
rows.current: text: 居然被一个顶着大蓬头发的小混混和她那帮轻浮跟班打下来了……

rows.source: ...and then some little brat stealing my gear!
rows.current: text: ……接着又有个小混蛋偷走了我的装备！

rows.source: Whatever, this is as good a place to start exploring as any.
rows.current: text: 管它呢，从这儿开始探索也没什么不好。

rows.source: Who knows, maybe there'll be some interesting creatures to find down here too!
rows.current: text: 谁知道呢，说不定下面也有些有趣的生物可找！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: What? Trying to spirit away again?
rows.current: text: 什么？又想溜走？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Come on! There's no way you're getting away like that!
rows.current: text: 少来！你休想就这么逃走！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Hang on lil bro, I'm about to show you some real flying!
rows.current: text: 抓紧了，弟弟，马上让你见识什么才叫真正的驾驶技术！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Watch me put this baby into overdrive, and then I'll-
rows.current: text: 看我让这宝贝全速运转，然后我就——

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……我就……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...this baby is having... problems!
rows.current: text: ……这宝贝出了点……问题！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: No!!!! She got away!!!
rows.current: text: 不！！！！她逃走了！！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: There's no way to catch up to her now, she's out of sight completely!
rows.current: text: 现在根本追不上她了，已经完全看不见她了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Darn it all!! If only this ship was fully repaired with all its parts!
rows.current: text: 真是可恶！！要是这艘飞船的零件都配齐、彻底修好了就好了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...I guess there's nothing else we can do, baby bro.
rows.current: text: ……我想我们也没别的办法了，小弟。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Just have to hope that Traeh doesn't manage to get her energy back...
rows.current: text: 只能希望Traeh没法恢复她的能量了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and hope that the galaxy is safe...
rows.current: text: ……也希望银河系平安无事……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Nooo! Curse you damn Yiffai siblings!
rows.current: text: 不要啊！诅咒你们，该死的伊吠姐弟！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was supposed to rule the world... no... the Galaxy!
rows.current: text: 我本该统治世界的……不……是整个银河！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And now... now...!
rows.current: text: 而现在……现在……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: GAAAAARRRRRRRGGGGGGGHGHHHH!
rows.current: text: 嘎啊啊啊——呜噢噢噢——呃呃呃！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Wow sis, did we really just... save a whole planet?
rows.current: text: 哇，姐姐，我们刚才真的……救了整整一颗星球？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Yeah lil bro, I think we did! Par for the course on my missions, really.
rows.current: text: 是啊，小弟，我想是的！在我执行的任务里这都算家常便饭了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Buuut pretty impressive for my baby bro's first real mission, so good going!
rows.current: text: 不——过嘛，对我家小弟的第一次真正任务来说已经相当厉害了，干得漂亮！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The heroes of Tutone! They return!
rows.current: text: 图托恩的英雄们！他们回来了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Traeh has been defeated, her psychic disturbances are no more and her minions flee!
rows.current: text: Traeh已被击败，她的灵能扰动不复存在，她的手下四散逃窜！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Cheers for the heroes!
rows.current: text: 为英雄们欢呼！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: YIP! YIP! HOORAY!
rows.current: text: YIP！YIP！好耶！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: YIP! YIP! HOORAY!
rows.current: text: YIP！YIP！好耶！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: BLESSED BE THE COSMOBREEDERS, SAVIORS OF OUR PLANET!
rows.current: text: 愿宇宙育种者受颂，我们星球的救星！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Wow, good going you two! Clearing out a whole planet of baddies...
rows.current: text: 哇，你们俩真棒！把整颗星球的坏蛋都清理干净了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: That's definitely gonna help the local fauna get back on track!
rows.current: text: 这肯定能帮当地的动物们重回正轨！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I knew you two could do it. Never had a doubt in my mind.
rows.current: text: 我就知道你们俩能做到。我心里从没怀疑过。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Not even when one of you went AWOL and stopped responding to all communica-
rows.current: text: 就连你们中有人擅离职守、不再回应任何通——

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: -Ahem...
rows.current: text: -嗯哼……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: This will definitely be a good report to have filed away, Agents!
rows.current: text: 这份报告绝对值得归档留存，特工们！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Nice one, grrrrl! You and your pup brother really cleaned up down there!
rows.current: text: 干得漂亮，姑娘！你和你那小狗崽弟弟，真把下面的坏蛋收拾干净了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Just don't forget about us at HQ when all the fame goes to your heads, alright?
rows.current: text: 不过就算出了名、得意起来，也别忘了总部的我们啊，好吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: HOORAH FOR YIFFANY AND YIFFAI! STAR COSMOBREEDERS!
rows.current: text: 为伊吠妮和伊吠欢呼！明星级宇宙育种者！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: H O O R A Y ! ! !
rows.current: text: 好 耶 ！ ！ ！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Heh, how about that, sis? We made a pretty good team, didn't we?
rows.current: text: 嘿，瞧见没，姐姐？我们配合得挺不错，不是吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Wellll... you did alright, bro.
rows.current: text: 嗯——……你还行啦，老弟。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...for a pup.
rows.current: text: ……就一只小崽子而言。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [SO ENDS THE REPORT ON PLANET TUTONE.]
rows.current: text: [图托恩星球的报告至此结束。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [A PLANET WITH A TUMULTUOUS HISTORY, FACING THE GREATEST CHALLENGES OF ITS TIME]
rows.current: text: [一颗历史动荡、正面临其时代最严峻挑战的星球]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [SAVED BY THE VALIANT EFFORTS OF TWO BRAVE COSMOBREEDERS:]
rows.current: text: [因两位勇敢的宇宙育种者的英勇努力而获救：]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [YIFFANY YIFFAI, ELDER SISTER AND SEASONED VETERAN WITH UNMATCHED COMBAT SKILL]
rows.current: text: [伊吠妮·伊吠，姐姐，久经沙场的老兵，拥有无与伦比的战斗技巧]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [AND YIFFAI YIFFAI, THE YOUNGER BROTHER PRODIGY WITH UNENDING ENTHUSIASM]
rows.current: text: [以及伊吠·伊吠，热情永不枯竭的天才弟弟]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [WITH THE TWO OF THEM TEAMED UP, THERE'S NO MISSION THAT THEY CAN'T HANDLE]
rows.current: text: [两人联手，没有他们应付不了的任务]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [AND THE PPP IS PROUD TO HAVE THEM AS AGENTS.]                      -SIGNED, BOSSU
rows.current: text: [PPP以拥有他们两位特工为荣。]                      ——署名：波苏

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ow, I didn't expect to take such a rough bump.
rows.current: text: 嗷，没想到会挨这么重的一下。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Guess I can use this chance to practice writing an end-of-capture report!
rows.current: text: 正好借机练习写获释后的被俘经历报告！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Lessee, just gotta start paying attention and see if anything notable happens
rows.current: text: 我看看……只要从现在开始留心，看看这段短短的……结束前，会发生什么值得记录的事。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: between now and the end of this short...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...little...
rows.current: text: ……稍微……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...napzzzz...z...
rows.current: text: ……睡觉……呼……噜……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Would you look at that? Must've slept for quite a while since I was all groggy
rows.current: text: 瞧瞧这事！我肯定睡了挺久，醒来还迷迷糊糊的，一醒来就发现自己正被套上拘束具！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and woke to find myself being locked into some restraints!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Not only that, but the jerks that were locking me into these cuffs...
rows.current: text: 不光如此，那些把我锁进镣铐的混蛋……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...looked just like that shorty that stole my gear to begin with!!
rows.current: text: ……居然跟一开始偷我装备的矮子长得一模一样！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As soon as they got me chained up in some sort of ramshackle den of theirs
rows.current: text: 他们刚把我锁进那破破烂烂的窝里，就开始轮流操我。都不先请我吃顿饭！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: they started to take turns rutting me. Didn't even get me dinner first or anything!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: With the shorties being so small it wasn't much of a workout for a pro like me
rows.current: text: 这些小矮子个头太小，对我这种老手根本算不上运动，不过我看得出，这些吱吱怪都急着发泄呢。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but I could tell that these squeakers were pretty desperate for some release.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was actually kinda fun to see the little fellas go to town on my tail...heh!
rows.current: text: 看这些小家伙对着我尾巴底下猛干，还挺有意思……嘿！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: One after another they took turns, must've been at least a dozen of them...
rows.current: text: 他们一个接一个轮着来，少说也有十几个……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The little guys only bred me one at a time but you could tell they were pent up
rows.current: text: 小家伙们一次只来一个，可光听他们吱吱喳喳，就知道都憋坏了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: by all the squeaking and chittering they were doing.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Every now and again one would get squeaked at for delaying the line
rows.current: text: 时不时就有一个因耽误排队，被吱吱叫着催促，还在射就被催着赶走了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and they'd get hurried along while still squirting!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Being the center of so much attention was actually kinda fun.
rows.current: text: 被这么多家伙团团围着，其实还挺好玩。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Learned a lot about their breeding habits
rows.current: text: 我学到了不少他们的交配习性，可惜没更大的个体供研究，我还真有点失望！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but I was almost dis- appointed that there were no larger specimens to study!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Almost, until I noticed that I was alone in the cell.
rows.current: text: 差点就是了，直到我发现牢房只剩我一个。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The little guys had left while I was getting lost in my thoughts, rude, right?
rows.current: text: 那帮小个子趁我走神时溜了，很没礼貌吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was just about to break out of there when my ears picked up the soft sounds of
rows.current: text: 我正准备逃出去，耳朵却捕捉到有人沿着石地悄悄靠近的轻微声响。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: someone creeping along the stones.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...along with some low growling...
rows.current: text: ……还伴着几声低吼……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Suddenly, out of the shadows came a giant beast of a creature!
rows.current: text: 突然，一头巨兽从阴影里走了出来！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: A muscled feline that could have probably torn me in half!
rows.current: text: 那只肌肉发达的大猫，恐怕能把我撕成两半！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But only because I was chained up!
rows.current: text: 可那也只是因为我被锁住了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Fortunately for him it was clear fighting wasn't what he had in mind.
rows.current: text: 算他走运，显然他没打算跟我打架。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I let him grab me however he wanted, since I was feeling kinda rowdy too, you know?
rows.current: text: 我任他想怎么抓就怎么抓，毕竟我也有点躁动了，懂吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Those little punks earlier were barely a warm up and I needed more!
rows.current: text: 之前那群小混蛋连热身都不够，我还没过瘾呢！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I tried to make it sound like I was having a rough time handling him, though...
rows.current: text: 不过，我故意哼得好像很难应付他似的……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You know, pretending like those giant pliable barbs of his were driving me crazy
rows.current: text: 你懂的，装作在他用壮实的腰臀狠狠往我里面撞时，被他那些又大又软的倒刺弄得快疯了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: as he plowed into me roughly with those great haunches of his...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was so busy pretending like I was losing myself in the sexual moment
rows.current: text: 我光顾着装出沉醉在性爱里的样子，差点没注意又有几只色猫围了过来。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: that I almost didn't notice the additional lusty cats circling around.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I... I figured it was probably a great opportunity to study the species more...
rows.current: text: 我……我想这大概是进一步研究这物种的好机会……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Besides, it's not like I was in any rush!
rows.current: text: 再说，我又不赶时间！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I knew I could break out of that cell and escape those brutes whenever I wanted to.
rows.current: text: 我知道，只要想逃，随时都能破牢而出，甩掉那些蛮兽。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Uhh if you're viewing this report, I guess it means I lost track of time
rows.current: text: 呃，你要是在看这份报告，想必是我忘了时间，然后有人正好撞见了逃到一半的我，是吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and someone stumbled across me mid-escape, huh?

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...you believe me, right?
rows.current: text: ……你信我的，对吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ouch! That last blow really ruffled my fluff!
rows.current: text: 嗷！刚才那一下真把我的毛都打乱了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But everyone's counting on me, so I gotta get back up and keep fighting!
rows.current: text: 可大家都指望着我呢，我得爬起来接着战斗！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Nnhg... just... need a moment... to lay here and catch my breath...
rows.current: text: 嗯呃……只要……在这躺一小会儿……喘口气……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but... so... so dizzy...
rows.current: text: ……可……好……好晕……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...huh?
rows.current: text: ……嗯？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Who are you...?
rows.current: text: 你是谁……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Hopefully the data recorders got all this. I seem to have been 'acquired' by
rows.current: text: 希望记录器都录下来了。我似乎被这片区域两种原生双足物种之一——哥布林“收归己有”了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: one of the two bipedal species native to this area, the Gobins.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As the big male carried me into the woods, I was still too dazed to put up a fight.
rows.current: text: 那大块头雄性把我抱进树林时，我还晕得无力反抗。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I tried to tell him that I was on a really important mission, but either
rows.current: text: 我想告诉他，我在执行重大任务，可他要么听不懂银河通用语……要么就是根本不在乎……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: he didn't speak galactic... or he just didn't care...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Once he got me back to the Gobin village, I was in for a really rude welcome!
rows.current: text: 他把我带回哥布林村后，那欢迎仪式可真粗暴！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: They immediately took turns passing me around and breeding me on the spot!!
rows.current: text: 他们当场就把我传来传去，轮流操了起来！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: They were so big, and they just used me like I was a toy.
rows.current: text: 他们那么大，把我当玩具一样随意玩弄。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Just jamming their hot Gobin cocks all the way up into my tummy, again and again!
rows.current: text: 一遍又一遍，把滚烫的哥布林鸡巴直捅到我肚子里！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was... Ugh... Rough... tiring... But kinda nice, at first...
rows.current: text: 那感觉……呃……粗暴……累人……可起初还挺舒服……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The others pawwed through my equipment, jabbering about it and sorting it.
rows.current: text: 其他家伙用爪子翻拣我的装备，叽里呱啦地分着类。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I didn't see any of that gear again. I think they sold it to space pirates...
rows.current: text: 那些装备我再也没见过，估计被卖给太空海盗了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Once they had their fill, they put me in a hanging cage at edge of the village.
rows.current: text: 他们尽兴后，把我关进村边悬吊的笼子里。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: After that? I'm not sure how long they kept me... A week? Two...?
rows.current: text: 再后来？我也不知被关了多久……一周？两周……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I don't think I ever got more than an hour of rest between rough breedings.
rows.current: text: 两次粗暴交配之间，我大概从没休息超过一小时。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The morning patrols... the afternoon patrols... I was free use for everyone!
rows.current: text: 早班巡逻……午班巡逻……谁都能随便用我！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: At least we'll have *plenty* of data on the male Gobin's breeding habits now,
rows.current: text: 至少现在，雄性哥布林的配种习性数据可*管够*了，全是我……啊……辛苦收集的！一寸……呃……*粗大*的一寸！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: collected by me... ah...! painstakingly...! inch by... ugh... *thick* inch!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Look, I'm a bottom agent right? I knew what I was signing up for...
rows.current: text: 听着，我是个下位特工，好吧？我知道自己报名来干嘛……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but jeez, even I've got my limits! This was all too much!
rows.current: text: ……可天哪，我也有极限！这实在太过了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I wanted to escape, but all those Gobin cocks really took the fight out of me...
rows.current: text: 我想逃，可那些哥布林的鸡巴把我操得没力气反抗了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and they kept a real close eye on me in my cage, too.
rows.current: text: ……他们还把笼里的我看得死死的。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Even the slightest untoward movement was an invitation for another rough pounding!
rows.current: text: 稍有不安分，就会招来又一顿粗暴猛干！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: So... as much as I'd like to say that I executed a brilliant escape plan...
rows.current: text: 所以……我很想说，是我施展了绝妙逃脱计划……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...it was really just dumb luck, the way it happened.
rows.current: text: ……其实事情就那么发生了，全靠瞎猫碰上死耗子。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The Gobins watching me were urgently called away one night.
rows.current: text: 有天夜里，看守我的哥布林被紧急叫走了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I think maybe one of their raids wasn't going well, but I'm not sure...
rows.current: text: 也许是他们哪次劫掠不太顺利，我也不确定……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Somehow, I scrambled down the nearest tree. My legs were shaking.
rows.current: text: 不知怎么的，我从最近的树上爬了下来，双腿直打颤。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I had no gear, no comms, stranded in the middle of an alien forest...
rows.current: text: 没装备、没通讯，我被困在外星森林深处……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: My only hope was to somehow make my way back to the hangar and regroup.
rows.current: text: 唯一的希望，就是设法回机库重整旗鼓。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but I didn't make it far before I was intercepted. Not by Gobins, thankfully.
rows.current: text: ……可没跑多远就被拦住了。幸好不是哥布林。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was a tall Elf lady. Someone who could speak my language, at least.
rows.current: text: 那是个高挑的精灵女子。至少终于有人会说我的语言了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But when I tried to explain about my super important rescue mission...
rows.current: text: 可我试着解释自己那超级重要的救援任务时……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...she just kept... cooing at me...?
rows.current: text: ……她却一直……柔声哄我……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I didn't have the strength to resist her as she led me away to the other elves
rows.current: text: 她领我去找其他精灵时，我已没力气反抗，很快，我就在幽静的林间泉水里，被他们围着伺候洗澡。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and soon I found myself fussed over and bathed in a quiet forest spring.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The elves ignored my weak protests, responding only with sweet nothings...
rows.current: text: 精灵们无视我软弱的抗议，只说着甜言蜜语……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: 'There there little one, just relax...' and so on.
rows.current: text: “乖，乖，小家伙，放松就好……”之类的。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: After my rough and messy Gobin captivity, this was all so relaxing...
rows.current: text: 被哥布林粗暴地折腾了那么久，这一切太放松了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...I guess I just kinda... melted... and let the elves do... hmmf...
rows.current: text: ……我好像就这么……酥软了……任由精灵们……嗯唔……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...whatever they wanted with me.
rows.current: text: ……随他们怎么摆弄我。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: My head swam. I felt... intoxicated...?
rows.current: text: 我头晕目眩，感觉……像醉了……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Was it something in the water here...? Or an Elfin PSY power...?
rows.current: text: 是这里的水有问题……？还是精灵的精神力……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Everything's a bit of a blur after that.
rows.current: text: 后来的事都记得有些模糊了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I just did as I was told, and it kept feeling better and better...
rows.current: text: 我只是乖乖照做，却越来越舒服……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: 'Come here puppy, into my lap... good puppy,' they cooed...
rows.current: text: 她们柔声哄道：‘过来，小狗，来我腿上……乖狗狗。’

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The few times my mission poked through the mind haze, I couldn't focus for long...
rows.current: text: 偶尔从迷糊中记起任务，也集中不了多久……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: 'Shush, little one. Open your legs... lift your tail...'
rows.current: text: ‘嘘，小家伙。张开腿……抬起尾巴……’

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now that I've collected my thoughts, everything has become totally clear.
rows.current: text: 如今整理好思绪，一切都彻底明白了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was foolish for me, a dumb little puppy, to think I could save the planet...
rows.current: text: 我这只傻小狗竟想拯救星球，真是愚蠢……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: My place is to follow along quietly and to serve my mistresses.
rows.current: text: 我就该安静跟随，侍奉我的女主人们。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: If you're watching this, know that the galaxy is in safe hands now.
rows.current: text: 看到这段录像的人请放心，银河如今有人守护了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Trust in the proud Elf rangers of Sceafya and their wise leader...
rows.current: text: 相信斯凯菲亚骄傲的精灵游侠，以及他们睿智的领袖吧……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Her peerless grace, my queen! High Lady Enelye!
rows.current: text: 风华绝代的陛下，我的女王！恩莉耶大人！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [Agent Yiffai did not return from his mission on Planet Tutone.]
rows.current: text: [特工伊吠前往图托恩星执行任务后，未能归来。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [He was last active on EXILE, a small asteroid orbiting the planet.]
rows.current: text: [他最后在流放地活动，那是一颗绕行星运行的小行星。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [Based on his final recordings, it is unlikely that the agent survived...]
rows.current: text: [根据最后的影像记录，该特工恐已遇难……]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [...but, as no remains have been recovered, his precise fate remains unclear.]
rows.current: text: [……但由于尚未寻获遗骸，他的确切下落仍不明。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [All agent communications from Tutone have since ceased.]
rows.current: text: [此后，图托恩所有特工的通讯都中断了。]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [Our mission logs indicate that some dark 'queen' might be in search of]
rows.current: text: [任务日志显示，某位黑暗“女王”可能正在寻找]

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: [a new host body, and may be seeking to expand her influence beyond Tutone...]
rows.current: text: [一具新宿主，或许还想把势力扩张到图托恩之外……]

rows.source: [STARDATE XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [PLANET TUTONE, 5555 SYSTEM] [MAGNETOSHEATH ENTRY POINT]
rows.current: text: [星历XXXX:XXXX:XXXX.XX] [5555星系，图托恩星] [磁鞘进入点]

rows.source: ...entry successful, en route to descend at 40N, 74W in T-minus XXXX unisecs.
rows.current: text: ……成功进入，正前往40N、74W下降点，距下降还有XXXX标准秒。

rows.source: Engine temp stable at 2640 degrees, plasma, oxygen and battery levels good.
rows.current: text: 引擎温度稳定在2640度，等离子、氧气和电量正常。

rows.source: This is Cosmobreeder Yiffai, requesting mission update from CO Bossu, over!
rows.current: text: 这里是宇宙育种者伊吠，请求波苏指挥官更新任务情报，完毕！

rows.source: Now listen up here agent Yiffai, you may have graduated top of your class
rows.current: text: 听好了，伊吠特工，你虽然以全班第一毕业，但凡还有别的选择，我们都不会派你执行这次任务。

rows.source: but we wouldn't have sent you on this mission if we had any other choice.
Oh come on, still worried because this is my first mission? I'll be on my toes!
rows.current: text: 拜托，还因为这是我第一次出任务而担心？我会保持警惕的！

rows.source: Especially if my sister was among the agents that disappeared mid-mission.
rows.current: text: 尤其姐姐可能就在那些任务中失踪的特工里。

rows.source: That's right, we can't be too careful. You're the only capable agent we had left.
rows.current: text: 没错，再谨慎也不为过。你是我们仅剩的能干特工了。

rows.source: Just remember, Tutone is having a mass exodus of fauna
rows.current: text: 记住，图托恩正在发生动物大规模外逃，

rows.source: and your job is to find out why!
rows.current: text: 你的任务就是查明原因！

rows.source: On top of that, you should also look for your missing fellow agents.
rows.current: text: 除此之外，你还得寻找失踪的特工同伴。

rows.source: Just make...sur...ou...on your...oes...or....
rows.current: text: 只要确……保……你……多加……小……心……

rows.source: Oh? What's this? Another little spacebug entering my domain?
rows.current: text: 哦？这是什么？又一只小太空虫闯进了我的领地？

rows.source: Enjoy your crash landing like your other little interlopers did, puppy!
rows.current: text: 小狗，跟其他小入侵者一样，好好享受坠机吧！

rows.source: Who the heck are you calling a pup?!?
rows.current: text: 你到底叫谁小狗呢？！？

rows.source: And how the heck did these ships sneak up on me?
rows.current: text: 还有，这些船到底怎么偷偷摸到我身边的？

rows.source: Gah! There's too many of them! I need to make an emergency landing!
rows.current: text: 啊！敌人太多了！我得紧急迫降！

rows.source: Commander! If you can hear me, I can't wait for permission, sorry!
rows.current: text: 指挥官！如果你听得见，抱歉，我等不及批准了！
text: ……疼。

rows.source: Geeeeeze, those buggy buggers did a number on my paint job!
rows.current: text: 天啊啊，那帮臭虫把我的涂装毁惨了！

rows.source: Don't they know that repairs and touch ups come out of my paycheck? The jerks...
rows.current: text: 她们难道不知道维修和翻新都得从我的工资里扣？混蛋……

rows.source: Post orbital thrusters are hecked up, but this jalopy of mine should still fly.
rows.current: text: 后轨道推进器坏了，不过我这老破船应该还能飞。

rows.source: Just need to get into this sneaking suit now that I'm terra bound, and...
rows.current: text: 既然落地了，先穿上这身潜行服，然后……

rows.source: What in the whatwhat!!
rows.current: text: 这都什么跟什么啊！！

rows.source: Who the heck are you!?! And what are you doing with my gear!?!
rows.current: text: 你到底是谁？！？拿我的装备干什么？！？

rows.source: That little punk just took my stuff and jumped down this hole!
rows.current: text: 那个小混蛋抢了我的东西，跳进这个洞了！

rows.source: ...now that I think about it, though...
rows.current: text: ……不过，现在仔细想想……

rows.source: ...I don't really remember where I was supposed to start my search...
rows.current: text: ……我不太记得该从哪里开始搜寻了……

rows.source: ...and it's starting to storm!
rows.current: text: ……还开始刮暴风雨了！

rows.source: Alright! No time to worry about it! Just gotta go for it!
rows.current: text: 好！没空发愁了！直接上就是！

rows.source: The local fauna and the safety of my fellow agents is depending on me!
rows.current: text: 当地动物和特工同伴的安危，都指望我了！
